## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

The *Jùshě Lùn Sòng Shū Jì* 俱舍論頌疏記 (CBETA X53n841) is a Tang dynasty 29-juan sub-commentary (*jì* 記) on 圓暉's *Jùshě lùn sòng shū* ([KR6l0036](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6l/KR6l0036), T1823), composed by the monk Dùnlín 遁麟 ([遁麟](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E9%81%81%E9%BA%9F)), a student of 圓暉. The text is preserved in the Xuzangjing (卍新纂大日本續藏經) Vol. 53, No. 841, with a table of contents covering juan 1 through 29. The first juan includes a section titled 釋序文 (glosses on the preface) before proceeding to the main commentary content chapter by chapter.

**Abstract**

Dùnlín 遁麟 (also known as Fùchūn shāmén 富春沙門 "the monk from Fùchūn"; fl. mid-to-late 8th century CE) was a student of 圓暉 ([圓暉](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E5%9C%93%E6%9A%89)) who composed this extensive sub-commentary covering nearly all 30 juan of 圓暉's *Sòng Shū*. The *Jì* genre (*jì* 記, "notes") represents a disciple's explanatory record of a teacher's commentary — a format central to the transmission of Chinese Buddhist scholasticism. At 29 juan, Dùnlín's *Jì* is the most substantial surviving sub-commentary on 圓暉's text and was particularly important for the transmission of the *Sòng Shū* tradition to Japan.
